summary.text: Father of Amopaon (`amopaon-trojan`), whom peerless Teucer laid on the bounteous earth with his mighty bow when the son of Telamon harried the Trojan battalions from behind Ajax's shield.

story.text: Homer names Polyaemon only as the father of Amopaon when Teucer, after slaying Daetor, Chromius, and godlike Lycophontes, smote Polyaemon's son to the bounteous earth — the seventh named in the eight warriors Ajax screened while the archer let fly his shafts.
